grades.main_gap: Step 1 (stabilization of the minimal prime-set family / finiteness of essential primes), the crux, is entirely unproven; Steps 2 and 3 are only sketched ideas, explicitly left as open issues.
grades.notes: Correct and useful reduction: validity depends only on radicals, phrased as transversals of the minimal family; sound overall strategy. But no part is actually proved — the write-up itself lists all three steps as 'must still be proved.' The verified example (a1=15, T=8, L=30) is computation, earning no credit.
